Loan Sales Executive - Salary Loans & Investments Job at Rosabon Financial Services




        
    

        
        Rosabon Financial Services (RFS) Limited -Award winning Rosabon Financial Services is a member of the Concept Group. Licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria, CBN on April 22, 1993 and being a long standing member of the Equipment Leasing Association of Nigeria (ELAN), the organization has evolved into Nigeria’s leading Non-Banking Financial Intermediary and Equipment Leasing firm focused on niche and general markets.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Loan Sales Executive - Salary Loans & Investments

Job Locations: Anambra, Delta, Lagos and Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time (Hybrid)

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Drive the sales of loans (Salary loan) and investment products.
	Source, onboard, and manage individual and corporate clients.
	Generate quality leads and convert them into business opportunities.
	Achieve and exceed monthly sales and revenue targets.


Requirements


	Minimum of an OND.
	0-3 years of proven experience in Loan sales or financial services products.
	Demonstrable track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Strong understanding of the local market and customer acquisition strategies.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Finance Manager Job at Firewood Rice Nigeria




        
    

        
        At Firewood Rice Nigeria, we don’t just serve meals - we serve memories. With a deep-rooted love for authentic Nigerian dishes, we’ve built a brand that delivers comfort, flavor, and joy to our customers across Lagos. Our energetic team is the secret sauce behind our success, and we’re growing fast! If you love food, innovation, and working in a vibrant, forward-thinking environment, we want you with us.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Finance Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	Lead financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes to support the strategic goals of the Firewood Jollof.
	Oversee financial reporting, including preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
	Monitor cash flow, working capital, and financial performance, providing insights to optimize resource allocation.
	Collaborate with other departments to develop cost control measures and improve operational efficiency.
	Conduct financial analysis to evaluate and support business decisions related to product development, pricing, and investments.
	Manage relationships with external auditors, banks, and regulatory authorities to enhance financial integrity and transparency.
	Inventory and Procurement monitoring (Market cost).
	Provide immediate support and training to the finance team on identified focus areas.
	Any other duties assigned by the management.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Operations Manager - Passenger Transport and Logistics",
  "description": "Vodstra Limited - Our client, a leading and well-established player in the passenger transport and logistics industry, is&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operations Manager - Passenger Transport and Logistics

Job Locations: Abuja (FCT), Aba - Abia, Onitsha - Anambra, Owerri - Imo, Lagos and Port Harcourt - Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Description


	We are seeking a high-energy, commercially driven and entrepreneurial Operations Manager.
	This is more than a traditional operations role. We need a business-minded transport professional.
	The successful candidates will be expected to think beyond simply moving buses, passengers and goods.
	They must understand how to fill seats, maximise cargo capacity, optimise vehicles and routes, control costs, develop people and deliver the financial targets expected from each trip and operating unit.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead daily transport operations, routes, terminals and operational teams.
	Maximise passenger occupancy, cargo volumes, vehicle utilisation and revenue per trip.
	Drive sales and business development to fill available passenger and cargo capacity.
	Manage drivers, frontline teams and other human resources effectively.
	Optimise fleet utilisation and minimise vehicle downtime and operational costs.
	Monitor financial and operational KPIs and take action to improve profitability.
	Identify new business opportunities, partnerships and revenue streams.


You should have


	Interested candidates should possess an OND / HND / Bachelor`s / Master`s Degree
	5+ years of relevant experience, including managerial experience.
	Experience in passenger transport or courier logistics
	Strong transport operations and fleet management skills.
	Proven sales/business development capability.

Job Position: Operations Manager - Passenger Transport and Logistics

Job Locations: Abuja (FCT), Aba - Abia, Onitsha - Anambra, Owerri - Imo, Lagos and Port Harcourt - Rivers

Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking a high-energy, commercially driven and entrepreneurial Operations Manager.
	This is more than a traditional operations role. We need a business-minded transport professional.
	The successful candidates will be expected to think beyond simply moving buses, passengers and goods.
	They must understand how to fill seats, maximise cargo capacity, optimise vehicles and routes, control costs, develop people and deliver the financial targets expected from each trip and operating unit.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead daily transport operations, routes, terminals and operational teams.
	Maximise passenger occupancy, cargo volumes, vehicle utilisation and revenue per trip.
	Drive sales and business development to fill available passenger and cargo capacity.
	Manage drivers, frontline teams and other human resources effectively.
	Optimise fleet utilisation and minimise vehicle downtime and operational costs.
	Monitor financial and operational KPIs and take action to improve profitability.
	Identify new business opportunities, partnerships and revenue streams.


You should have


	Interested candidates should possess an OND / HND / Bachelor`s / Master`s Degree
	5+ years of relevant experience, including managerial experience.
	Experience in passenger transport or courier logistics
	Strong transport operations and fleet management skills.
	Proven sales/business development capability.
	Strong understanding of load factor, vehicle utilisation, revenue per trip and profitability.
	Excellent people-management and leadership skills.
	Experience managing drivers and large frontline teams.

	Strong financial and commercial awareness.
	Strong problem-solving ability.

	We are looking for someone who has previously worked as an Operations Manager, Head of Operations, Transport Manager, Branch/Terminal Manager or similar senior role in a transport, logistics, consolidated cargo/haulage or mobility company.

	If you see empty seats as lost revenue, unused vehicle capacity as a business opportunity, and operational challenges as problems to solve, this opportunity may be for you.

Deputy Warehouse Coordinator Job at Bourbon Interoil Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Bourbon Interoil Nigeria Limited, as leading international player in marine services, offers to the most demanding oil & gas clients worldwide a full line of innovative, safe, high performance and new generation vessels and an expanded offer of offshore oil & gas services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Deputy Warehouse Coordinator

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Job type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Deputy Warehouse Coordinator is responsible for controlling all stock movements and inventories, especially the accuracy between physical and ORACLE stock image.
	He is the one to run and prepare the weekly replenishment order (Min Max). He shall also replace the Senior Warehouse Coordinator during his leave and handle the warehouse housekeeping


Job Details


	Follow receipt, storage, and timely delivery of goods and materials:
	Replace the Senior Warehouse Coordinator during his leave and for duty rotation on week ends
	Assist the Senior Warehouse Coordinator to identify areas of improvement and establish innovative or adjust existing work procedures and practices.
	Ensure vendors’ deliveries are received and checked with end users
	Control full accuracy between documentation, deliveries and dispatches
	Prepare any necessary documentation, especially ORACLE reports and dispatch them properly
	Control the arrangements of materials / spare parts properly in the container upon delivery
	Control the dispatch of materials / spare parts as required by vessels and end users
	Handle stock movements in ORACLE
	Prepare inventory as requested by the Senior Warehouse Coordinator
	Organize and maintain inventory and storage area
	Ensure shipments’ and inventory transactions’ accuracy
	Handle permanent turning and sampling inventories
	Ensure 100% of items are physically counted at least once per year
	Maintain items record, document necessary information and utilize reports to project warehouse status
	Prepare Mini-Max, security stocks and automatic reorders
	Prepare report on mini-max levels and automatic reorders plan on a weekly basis
	Communicating and coordinating with other departments and customers.
	Assist the Senior Warehouse Coordinator to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction through excellence in receiving, identifying, dispatching and assuring quality of goods
	Jointly work with the Senior Warehouse Coordinator to Measure and report the effectiveness of warehousing activities and employees performance.
	Ensure proper respect of HSE rules and requirements, housekeeping and maintenance
	Respect of basic maintenance standards and compliance with health and safety regulations.
	Performing a daily inspection of the warehouse grounds.
	Coordinating and maintaining material and equipment.
	Keep the work area clean and tidy
	Good and safe storekeeping


Requirements


	A Degree in Social science, Management, Accounting, Finance or Engineering or related discipline is required
	Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Warehousing, Stock Controlling, HSE and Supply Chain in a Marine & Logistics Industry
